protein: VKOR / VKORC1 (vitamin K epoxide reductase, oxidoreductase)
readout: Carboxylation activity, read out as fluorescence of a carboxylation-specific antibody bound to cell-surface Factor IX; higher is more active
assay_method: FACS-based deep mutational scan of VKOR in human cells. Functioning VKOR carboxylates a co-expressed Factor IX gla domain, which is secreted and retained at the cell surface, where a fluorophore-labelled carboxylation-specific antibody reports it. A library of 697 missense mutations made with mutagenesis primers was sorted into quartile bins by APC intensity and each bin deeply sequenced. Per-variant scores were taken from the authors' MaveDB deposit.
remark: The sequence is UniProt Q9BQB6 exactly, 163 aa, and every label verifies against it. 14 nonsense rows are dropped, a premature stop not being writable as a substitution. 36 synonymous row(s) are the wild-type protein and collapse to the single WT row at their mean. This paper yields two datasets because it measures two different properties of the same variants: carboxylation activity and, by VAMP-seq, steady-state abundance. They are separate work items, not two readouts of one.
